answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed desert oasis well, where the keeper measures the water level daily and records it on an ivory marble plaque engraved by an independent stonemason. Random audits summon the keeper to read the plaque live on camera within minutes, so one operator cannot staff two wells at once. The well license fee in outside money doubles per further well on the same funding trail, so each extra fake identity costs another real well, another daily keeper, another engraved plaque, and twice the prior fee.
